Plugin.Name: NBD Export
Plugin.Overview: Export a disk or partition as a Network Block Device and image remote nbd:// targets to qcow2 or raw. Settings, Network Services, NBD next to NFS and SMB. Needs qemu-nbd and qemu-img usually with Unraid VMs. Read-only by default; prefer private or Thunderbolt binds. Min Unraid 6.12 product; not a kernel feature. Thunderbolt Net optional for underlay.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: NBD qemu-nbd qemu-img block export imaging NbdExport
